title: knowledge(performance): add trigger-only fields to API pages with AddLoadFields
summary: New knowledge article documents how to use AddLoadFields on API pages to prevent JIT loading failures when accessing unbound fields in OnAfterGetRecord.
key_points: Explains that unbound Rec fields read in OnAfterGetRecord on API pages cause per-row JIT loads
Recommends Rec.AddLoadFields in OnOpenPage to avoid 'Inconsistent read' and JIT loading failures
Warns against Rec.SetLoadFields in OnOpenPage because it replaces the platform's layout-based field selection
Adds bad and good AL examples for the pattern
Registers the new article in the evaluation review fixtures
